description: Dolphin log/panic-alert signatures. Strings verified against Dolphin master source (Core/Boot/Boot.cpp, VideoBackends/D3D12, VideoBackends/Vulkan).

rules.title: Dolphin does not recognise the game file
patterns: is an invalid GCM/ISO file, or is not a GC/Wii ISO
rules.probableCause: The file is not a valid GameCube/Wii image (corrupt, truncated, or a different console's game).
manual: Verify the game file (Dolphin can verify dumps from its game properties).

rules.title: The game file does not exist
patterns: The specified file ".*" does not exist
Files specified in the M3U file
No paths found in the M3U file
rules.probableCause: The game was moved/deleted, its drive is disconnected, or a multi-disc playlist points at missing discs.
manual: Reconnect the drive that holds your games.

rules.title: Direct3D 12 failed to start in Dolphin
patterns: Failed to create D3D12 global resources
rules.probableCause: Your GPU or driver does not support Dolphin's Direct3D 12 backend.

rules.title: Dolphin could not create its game window
patterns: Failed to create D3D swap chain
rules.probableCause: The Direct3D renderer could not attach to the window, often due to a driver or overlay conflict.
manual: Disable screen overlays (recording/FPS tools) and try again.

rules.title: Vulkan failed to start in Dolphin
patterns: Vulkan: Failed to find an acceptable (graphics|present) queue
rules.probableCause: Your GPU driver's Vulkan support is missing or incomplete.

rules.title: GameCube IPL not found
patterns: Cannot start the game, because the GC IPL could not be found
rules.probableCause: Dolphin was told to boot through the GameCube main menu (IPL) but no IPL is installed.
manual: Either add an IPL dumped from your own GameCube in BIOS & Firmware, or disable 'Skip main menu' changes.

rules.title: GameCube IPL is not a known good dump
patterns: The IPL file is not a known good dump
rules.probableCause: The IPL file is damaged or modified.
manual: Re-dump the IPL from your own console, or remove it (Dolphin works without one).
